author: nickyeow

english.text: As he had no way of making fire, he ate the fish raw.

jyutping: keoi5 hei2 m4 dou3 fo2，wai4 jau5 saang1 sik6 tiu4 jyu4。
text: 佢起唔到火，唯有生食條魚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Must I go there at once?

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 mai6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 heoi3 aa3？
text: 我係咪一定要即刻去呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I ate some bread and a boiled egg for lunch.

jyutping: ngo5 ng5 caan1 sik6 zo2 gei2 faai3 min6 baau1 tung4 maai4 jat1 zek3 hap6 daan6。
text: 我午餐食咗幾塊麵包同埋一隻烚蛋。

author: nickyeow

english.text: God, you piss me off. You completely ruined the moment.

jyutping: diu2，ngo5 zan1 hai6 bei2 nei5 ceoi1 zoeng3。nei5 jyun4 cyun4 po3 waai6 zo2 go3 hei3 fan1 lo1。
text: 屌，我真係俾你吹脹。你完全破壞咗個氣氛囉。

author: kaenif

english.text: Damn! Swiss trains have everything!

jyutping: ding2！seoi6 si6 di1 fo2 ce1 mat1 dou1 jau5 ge3！
text: 頂！瑞士啲火車乜都有嘅！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom won $10,000 in the lottery.

jyutping: tong1 mou5 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 jeng4 zo2 jat1 pei4 je5。
text: 湯姆買六合彩贏咗一皮嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He pays with a credit card.

jyutping: keoi5 jung6 seon3 jung6 kaat1 bei2 cin4。
text: 佢用信用咭俾錢。

author: fercheung

english.text: Tom is reading a book.

jyutping: aa3 Tom hai2 dou6 tai2 gan2 syu1。
text: 阿Tom喺度睇緊書。

author: fercheung

english.text: What's your favorite brand of yogurt?

jyutping: nei5 zung1 ji3 bin1 zek3 paai4 zi2 ge3 jyu5 lok6 aa3？
text: 你鍾意邊隻牌子嘅乳酪呀？

author: fercheung

english.text: He works as a teacher, but actually he is a spy.

jyutping: biu2 min6 soeng6 keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 lou5 si1，kei4 sat6 keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 gaan3 dip6。
text: 表面上佢係一個老師，其實佢係一個間諜。

author: dngzz1

english.text: Do you often meet him?

jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 gin3 keoi5 gaa3 me1？
text: 你成日見佢架咩？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Holy crap, who's the asshole who dares call me in the middle of the night?!

jyutping: diu2，bin1 tiu4 puk1 gaai1 bun3 je6 saam1 gaang1 daa2 bei2 ngo5 aa3？！
text: 屌，邊條仆街半夜三更打俾我呀？！

author: kaenif

english.text: He saved the situation.

jyutping: keoi5 cing2 gau3 zo2 gin6 si6。
text: 佢拯救咗件事。

author: kaenif

english.text: No one believes what Tom says anymore.

jyutping: mou5 jan4 wui5 zoi3 seon3 aa3 Tom gong2 ge3 je5。
text: 冇人會再信阿Tom講嘅嘢。

author: kaenif

english.text: Are you proud of your father?

jyutping: nei5 hai6 mai6 wai6 nei5 aa3 baa4 gam2 dou3 zi6 hou4？
text: 你係咪為你阿爸感到自豪？

author: kaenif

english.text: Old habits die hard.

jyutping: gong1 saan1 jik6 goi2，bun2 sing3 naan4 ji4。
text: 江山易改，本性難移。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who's your favorite philosopher?

jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 zit3 hok6 gaa1 hai6 bin1 go3？
text: 你最鍾意嘅哲學家係邊個？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom taught me a lot of useful things.

jyutping: aa3 Tom gaau3 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1 jau5 jung6 ge3 je5。
text: 阿Tom教咗我好多有用嘅嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He helps us.

jyutping: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 dei6。
text: 佢幫我哋。

author: WilliamKwok

english.text: I will live.

jyutping: ngo5 wui6 sang1 cyun4 lok6 heoi3。
text: 我会生存落去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If that happens again, call me.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 hai6 gam3 zau6 daa2 bei2 ngo5 laa1。
text: 如果再係咁就打俾我啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's realistic and doesn't believe in the possibility of miracles.

jyutping: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jin6 sat6，m4 seon3 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 jau5 kei4 zik1。
text: 佢份人好現實，唔信世界上有奇跡。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can you please cut down on the swearing? You're setting a bad example for the kids.

jyutping: hou2 sam1 nei5 gong2 siu2 geoi3 cou1 hau2 laa1，gaau3 waai6 sai3 lou6 aa1。
text: 好心你講少句粗口啦，教壞細路呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wouldn't call myself a sentimental person, but it brought tears to my eyes.

jyutping: ngo5 zi6 man6 m4 hai6 di1 me1 gam2 sing3 ge3 jan4，daan6 hai6 dou1 tai2 dou2 ngaan5 sap1 sap1。
text: 我自問唔係啲咩感性嘅人，但係都睇到眼濕濕。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The lawyer needed to take the interests of both parties into consideration.

jyutping: go3 leot6 si1 jiu3 haau2 leoi6 soeng1 fong1 ge3 lei6 jik1。
text: 個律師要考慮雙方嘅利益。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: I cannot understand my school mate's Cantonese.

jyutping: ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4 tung4 hok6 gong2 ge3 jyut6 jyu5。
text: 我聽唔明同學講嘅粵語。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Maybe everything you need to know is in this book.

jyutping: waak6 ze2 ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 cai4 saai3 nei5 seoi1 jiu3 zi1 ge3 je5 ne1。
text: 或者呢本書有齊晒你需要知嘅嘢呢。

english.text: "Well, in the first place, I don't think my ideal would speak like that," said she. "He would be a harder, sterner man, not so ready to adapt himself to a silly girl's whim. But, above all, he must be a man who could do, who could act, who would look Death in the face and have no fear of him—a man of great deeds and strange experiences."

jyutping: 「hou2 laa1，sau2 sin1，ngo5 m4 gok3 dak1 ngo5 ge3 lei5 soeng2 wui5 gam2 gong2 je5，」keoi5 waa6。 「keoi5 wui5 hai6 jat1 go3 gang1 koeng4 ngaang6、gang1 jim4 lai6 ge3 jan4，m4 wui5 gam2 zeon2 bei6 hou2 sik1 jing3 jat1 go3 so4 neoi5 zai2 ge3 kei4 soeng2。daan6 hai6，zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 hai6，keoi5 jat1 ding6 hai6 jat1 go3 ho2 ji5 zou6 je5、ho2 ji5 hang4 dung6、wui5 mong6 zyu6 sei2 mong4 ge3 lim5，daan6 hai6 mou5 je5 ge3 jan4。」 hung2 geoi6 keoi5 —— jat1 go3 jau5 wai5 daai6 si6 zik1 tung4 kei4 gwaai3 ging1 lik6 ge3 jan4。」
text: 「好啦，首先，我唔覺得我嘅理想會噉講嘢，」佢話。 「佢會係一個更強硬、更嚴厲嘅人，唔會噉準備好適應一個傻女仔嘅奇想。但係，最重要嘅係，佢一定係一個可以做嘢、可以行動、會望住死亡嘅臉，但係冇嘢嘅人。」 恐懼佢 —— 一個有偉大事蹟同奇怪經歷嘅人。」

english.text: There, ministering justice, she presides, / and deals the law, and from her throne of state, / as choice determines or as chance decides, / to each, in equal share, his separate task divides. / Sudden, behold a concourse. Looking down, / his late-lost friends AEneas sees again, / Segestus, brave Cloanthus of renown, / Antheus and others of the Trojan train, / whom the black squall had scattered o'er the main, / and driven afar upon an alien strand.

jyutping: hai2 go2 dou6，zap1 hang4 zing3 ji6，keoi5 zyu2 ci4， / tung4 cyu2 lei5 faat3 leot6，ji4 hai2 keoi5 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 bou2 zo6， / dong1 syun2 zaak6 kyut3 ding6 waak6 ze2 dong1 gei1 wui6 kyut3 ding6， / deoi3 mui5 go3 jan4，ping4 dang2 dei2 fan1 hoeng2，keoi5 ge3 duk6 laap6 jam6 mou6 fan1 lit6 / dat6 jin4，tai2 haa2 jat1 go3 daai6 tong4。 mong6 lok6 heoi3， / keoi5 ji5 gu3 ge3 pang4 jau5 oi1 nei4 aa3 si1 jau6 gin3 dou2， / sak1 gat1 si1 tou4 si1，jung5 gam2 ge3 hak1 laan4 tou4 si1， / on1 dak6 sau1 si1 tung4 muk6 maa5 fo2 ce1 ge3 kei4 taa1 jan4， / hak1 sik1 bou6 fung1 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 saan3 lok6 heoi3 hai2 zyu2 sin3 soeng6 min6， / tung4 maai4 hai2 jat1 tiu4 ngoi6 sing1 jan4 ge3 hoi2 ngon6 soeng6 min6 zaa1 dou2 hou2 jyun5。
text: 喺嗰度，執行正義，佢主持， / 同處理法律，而喺佢嘅國家寶座， / 當選擇決定或者當機會決定， / 對每個人，平等地分享，佢嘅獨立任務分裂 / 突然，睇吓一個大堂。 望落去， / 佢已故嘅朋友埃尼亞斯又見到， / 塞吉斯圖斯，勇敢嘅克蘭圖斯， / 安特修斯同木馬火車嘅其他人， / 黑色暴風將佢哋散落去喺主線上面， / 同埋喺一條外星人嘅海岸上面揸到好遠。

english.text: When I come back to the country [who knows if this virus will leave us a respite or attack us again], ask me again to continue my translation into Kabyle of the French text that I already wrote on couscous; and that I titled "Awer ifuṛ, awer yeṛdem". No doubt I will use your lexical text wisely so that every Kabyle, woman and man, is proud of it. So, please don't forget!

jyutping: dong1 ngo5 faan2 dou3 heoi3 ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 si4 hau6［bin1 go3 zi1 dou3 ni1 go3 beng6 duk6 wui5 m4 wui5 lau4 dai1 ngo5 dei6 jat1 go3 jau1 sik1 ge3 si4 gaan3，ding6 hai6 wui5 zoi3 gung1 gik1 ngo5 dei6］，zoi3 giu3 ngo5 gai3 zuk6 zoeng1 ngo5 ji5 ging1 hai2 zing1 cou1 mak6 fan2 soeng6 min6 se2 gwo3 ge3 faat3 man2 man4 zi6 faan1 jik6 sing4 Kabyle ； 「ifuṛ, awer yeṛdem」。hou4 mou4 ji4 man6，ngo5 wui5 ming4 zi3 gam2 jung6 nei5 ge3 ci4 wui6 man4 zi6，ling6 mui5 go3 kaa1 bei2 ji5 jan4，mou4 leon6 neoi5 jan2 ding6 naam4 jan2，dou1 wai6 keoi5 gam2 dou3 giu1 ngou6。so2 ji5，ceng2 nei5 m4 hou2 mong4 gei3！
text: 當我返到去呢個國家嘅時候［邊個知道呢個病毒會唔會留低我哋一個休息嘅時間，定係會再攻擊我哋］，再叫我繼續將我已經喺蒸粗麥粉上面寫過嘅法文文字翻譯成 Kabyle ； 「ifuṛ, awer yeṛdem」。毫無疑問，我會明智噉用你嘅詞彙文字，令每個卡比爾人，無論女人定男人，都為佢感到驕傲。所以，請你唔好忘記！
